en: Black-and-white postcard showing an outdoor café terrace with many empty folding chairs and tables beside a calm river or lake. Several people sit at a few tables in the foreground, while others are boating in rowboats on the water. Dense forested hills surround the water. At the bottom of the image there is a printed caption in German indicating the location as Volkspark "Buschmühle", Niederau-Oberau.
